summary_for_children: Al-Kahf has four stories: young believers who slept in a cave, a man proud of his two gardens, Musa's journey to learn from a knowing servant of Allah, and Dhul-Qarnayn who built a barrier.
environment_concept: Four connected adventures: the cave of the young believers, the two gardens, the meeting of the two seas, and the iron barrier.
architecture_and_scenery: Mountain cave with sunlight sliding past its mouth, two walled gardens with a river, a meeting of two seas with a ship and a leaning wall, and a pass sealed by iron and copper.

palette.lighting: Shafts of light in the cave, bright gardens, sea light, forge glow
palette.atmosphere: Cool cave air, garden breeze, sea mist, mountain wind

areas.name: The Cave
areas.description: A mountain cave; the youths are never shown and no number is stated.

areas.name: The Sliding Sun
areas.description: Sunlight passing by the cave's mouth.

areas.name: The Two Gardens
areas.description: Two walled gardens with a river between.

areas.name: The Ship
areas.description: A small ship with a hole in its side.

areas.name: The Wall
areas.description: A wall about to fall, set straight.

areas.name: The Iron Barrier
areas.description: A mountain pass filled with iron and copper.

activities.name: Retell the four journeys
activities.description: Put the places of the four journeys in the order the surah tells them: the cave, the gardens, the meeting of the seas, and the barrier.
activities.label: artistic educational adaptation, not an event in the Quran

activities.name: Match each place to its ayah
activities.description: Match each place in the valley to the ayah it comes from.
activities.label: artistic educational adaptation, not an event in the Quran

activities.name: Why did it happen?
activities.description: At the ship and the wall, read the reasons given in 18:79-82 and talk about patience in learning.
activities.label: artistic educational adaptation, not an event in the Quran

narration_plan: Each journey opens with its ayahs, then gentle explanation. Musa, the knowing servant and Dhul-Qarnayn are never shown.

status.playable_environment: first version built: its own valley of four journeys (cave with sliding sunlight, two gardens and a river, two waters meeting, a holed ship, a mended wall, an iron and copper barrier) and two playable games
status.testing: checked in headless Chromium with software WebGL at 1280x800; not tested on phones or real GPUs
status.tested_by: automated screenshots of the scene and the journey game

depiction_rules: No prophet, person or representation of Allah is shown. Unseen realities are never pictured. Interactive activities are labelled as adaptations.
